headline: Banswara Syntex appoints Dinesh Nolkha as Non-Executive Independent Director
summary: Banswara Syntex Limited announced the appointment of Mr. Dinesh Nolkha as an Additional Director in the Non-Executive Independent Director category, effective November 3, 2026. headline: Banswara Syntex announces cessation of Independent Director Jagdeesh Mal Mehta
summary: Banswara Syntex Limited has informed the stock exchanges that Mr. Jagdeesh Mal Mehta will cease to be a Non-Executive Independent Director of the company. The cessation is effective from October 26, 2026. Such board changes are routine corporate governance updates for listed entities. Indian retail investors holding the stock should note leadership transitions as part of ongoing company evaluations.
